title: Ship-To Fulfillment Account Portfolio Principles
content:
These principles govern how the ship-tos of one customer relate to each other on the Ship-To Fulfillment Account.

**Each ship-to stands alone.** Each ship-to is its own service level: minimum order, free freight, expedites included, fees and return terms are applied per ship-to and per order, never pooled across the customer's ship-tos. Orders for different ship-tos never combine toward a free freight threshold or a minimum order, even when shipped the same day.

**Entry gates (clause no longer in force).** The following clause is no longer in force and has been superseded by the current basis: "Service level entry gates are measured on the ship-to's own trailing 12 month spend, except that a new ship-to of a customer whose other active ship-tos together had trailing 12 month spend of at least the requested level's entry gate may open at that level for its first 12 months."

**One account for billing.** All ship-tos bill to the customer's single Commercial Credit Account; a ship-to never carries its own terms.

### Points of judgement

| Situation | Treatment under these principles |
|---|---|
| Two ship-tos of one customer each ship an order on the same day | each order is tested against its own ship-to's free freight threshold and minimum order; the two orders never combine |
| One ship-to has used its included expedites for the month | another ship-to's included expedites are not drawn on; expedites included are per ship-to |
| A ship-to's invoice | billed to the customer's single Commercial Credit Account; the ship-to carries no terms of its own |

superseded_clauses: Service level entry gates are measured on the ship-to's own trailing 12 month spend, except that a new ship-to of a customer whose other active ship-tos together had trailing 12 month spend of at least the requested level's entry gate may open at that level for its first 12 months.
